name: Leala Cenric
source:
The ward from the Cenrics. [url=/c146901]Cerys[/url] seems fond of her, despite Leala being from a Family at odds with the Gryms.

Leala is a talented striker, having played for her university's football team and now signed to a contract with the team her family owns.

Cer believes Leala is less venomously ambitious than the rest of her family. Mostly, due to Leala's prior relationship with [url=/c146928]Orlaith[/url] during Orlaith's time with the Cenrics. Leala apparently asked about Orlaith after her sudden departure last year.

[In game description]
